messages:
talia: Quick sync from design review: noticed a few compliance UX nits in Project Settings > Data controls. Main items: (1) region selector keyboard/tab flow collapses unexpectedly when coming from the retention dropdown, (2) the key badge copy is being misread by customers, and (3) audit log CSV export timestamps are ambiguous for auditors. Can we triage small fixes this sprint?

ben: Repro for #1: Tab into Retention, open dropdown, then Tab to Region. Region trigger gains focus but the options collapse before focus reaches the list. Happens in Chrome and Firefox.

priya: Sounds like a blur focus race. Short fix: move the options container immediately after the trigger in DOM order, keep aria-expanded=true on the trigger until the list actually gets focus, and only close on Escape or click-out. Also add role="listbox" and manage aria-activedescendant so screen readers announce items.

ben: I'll prototype that. Also plan to programmatically move focus into the first option if the list is open when the user Tabs into the region trigger.

talia: Nice. On #2 support is getting tickets: people read "Managed key \u2014 Redwood" and assume Redwood can decrypt their blobs. Need compact, unambiguous pill copy for list rows. Drafts: 
- "Key custody: Redwood"
- "Key custody: Customer (BYOK)"
- compact fallback "Custody: Redwood / Customer (BYOK)"
We also need an accessible explainer (aria-describedby) and a small help icon that opens a short modal.

support-bot: Support request: please include canonical one-line we can paste: "Key custody \u2014 Redwood-managed / Customer-managed (BYOK). BYOK means you provide key material; Redwood does not have access to your key material." Also request a telemetry hint data-key-custody="redwood|customer" on the settings row for triage. Ensure we don't include any KMS identifiers; retention 90 days.

priya: Accessibility note: the current pill hover contrast for 12px microcopy measures ~3.6:1 which fails WCAG AA for small text. Fix options: increase weight to 600 and darken bg slightly. Also ensure a visible focus ring (3px) and add aria-describedby linking to a hidden explainer: "Who can rotate or revoke the master key."

ben: I'll update the CSS to meet >=4.5:1, include before/after swatches and WCAG numbers in the PR. I'll also add aria-describedby and the modal trigger.

talia: On #3 CSV export: current behavior = console shows local time but exported CSVs are in UTC which confuses auditors. Ops/security prefer unambiguous exports. Proposal: export ISO-8601 with timezone offset (e.g., 2026-04-01T14:23:00-07:00) and change header to "Timestamp (your timezone)" with a tooltip showing exact offset and a toggle to view UTC.

ben: Agreed. I'll change exports to ISO+offset and add a small note in the export dialog: "CSV uses ISO-8601 with timezone offset for auditability." Also will add an e2e test that parses CSV and asserts offsets are present.

priya: Mobile/UI nit: in narrow widths the help icon gets hidden behind the pill. For widths <420px hide the icon and show a one-line "Learn more" link under the row that opens the modal. Ensure modal is keyboard-accessible and announced by screen readers.

eq-bot: CI check: current branch fails contrast check and keyboard-nav test for region picker. Recommend attaching VoiceOver notes and screenshots to PR.

talia: Plan: ben will PR DOM reorder + role/listbox + focus-into-first-option + CSS contrast changes + export ISO change + telemetry attr. priya will draft modal copy and hidden explainer and add VoiceOver notes. support-bot will confirm canned reply and telemetry retention. Aim for PR by EOD Thursday.

ben: I'll include screenshots and contrast numbers in the PR and a keyboard test. Tagging for review.

talia: Thanks all! Closing after PR merge. :white_check_mark:
